title: Mexican Chicken Toast
description: A crunchy and savory Mexican-inspired dish featuring toasted bread topped with chicken, crunchy elements, and a hint of warmth.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan over medium heat.
2. Cook the chicken breast until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C). Let it rest and then shred it.
3. Toast the bread until it's lightly browned.
4. Fry the tortilla strips in a pan until they're crispy.
5. In the same pan, add the warm salsa and let it simmer for a few minutes.
6. Assemble the toast by spreading the salsa on the toasted bread, followed by the shredded chicken, crispy tortilla strips, and shredded cheese (if using).
7. Sprinkle with cumin and salt and pepper to taste.
